{{Term/Store|Bonus Chest|Bonus Chests|Series, BotW|plural}} are [[Object]]s in {{BotW}}.<ref>{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 377}}</ref>

==Location and Uses==
Bonus Chests are special [[Treasure Chest]]s that are made available upon purchasing the ''[[Breath of the Wild Expansion Pass]]''. Three Bonus Chests will appear throughout the [[Great Plateau]]. They are identical to [[Hidden Chest]]s and resemble [[Metal Chest]]s but with purple bodies and the English letters "EX" on their faces.

Because Bonus Chests are metallic, they can conduct [[Electricity]] and may attract [[Lightning]]. They can be manipulated using the [[Magnesis]] and [[Stasis]] [[Rune]]s. Both the [[Camera]] Rune and the [[Sheikah Sensor +]] functions of the [[Sheikah Slate]] treat Bonus Chests like any other Treasure Chest.
